registration_note: Formal scorer preregistration written after mechanical trace validation and before any grammar, human-control, n-gram comparator or FHRR score is revealed. Mechanical outcome already observed: 3 complete insertion pairs among 4 oracle-identified omissions. No prior score was invented or accepted from the malformed replacement runs.

trace_validation.complete_pair_requires: forced missing word survives every primitive veto, then the original following word survives against the same veto chain and is retained; no forced next token or bypass
trace_validation.history: includes prompt; generated prefix equals the last step tokens, exactly the omitted prompt-prefix convention of the launcher

corpus_grammar_scorer.model: the untouched training-fitted structural scorer used by this arm, including the UD-EWT WordNet order tagger and trained dependency/transition log probabilities
corpus_grammar_scorer.threshold: fifth percentile of restored-minus-deleted structural scores on the calibration split
corpus_grammar_scorer.accepted_correction: strictly greater than threshold + 0.05 * abs(threshold); no grammar score means no action
corpus_grammar_scorer.position: annotate only four already identified engine omissions (prompts 9, 11, 12, 17); retained oracle position and correct token are controls, never proposed as a deployable general repair

human_controls.source: the existing external-blind zero-error human items; no human text is modified on disk
human_controls.eligible: complete 8-30 word sentences outside the two-sentence prompt excerpt; de-duplicate by (prompt, sentence start, end) and use at most two unique units per control
human_controls.split: hash unit identifier with SHA-256; even first byte is calibration, odd is held-out before any grammar score is inspected
human_controls.deletions: omit each eligible in-vocabulary word at its exact frozen human trace step, with its true original availability and up to seven unique alternative surviving tokens
human_controls.held_out_collateral_edit: accept deletion when its restoration structural delta is at most the frozen threshold; report raw count and exact one-sided binomial tail at p=0.05, without claiming significance from zero events
human_controls.recovery: correct restored token top-1 and top-5 among the same candidate pool; n-gram comparator uses the kernel alpha=0.4 interpolated 1-5 gram score; compare without an external judge

primary_gate.collateral: held-out clean-human false-edit rate at most 0.05 and exact binomial p <= 0.05
primary_gate.interpretation: small repair-feasibility pilot only; no BOOKS-beaten or gap-closing claim and no generation bench unless separately registered

semantics.simple_salience: record difference in the existing discourse-state salience for the inserted word and competing words, diagnostic only
semantics.fhrr: only use the kernel exposed harmonic/role callback if verified in source; do not relabel scalar salience as FHRR, coherence, role satisfaction or grammar

rejections: R7 and R8 optional/off; R9 and R11 remain closed; R10 remains skipped; no default engine edit is authorized by this pilot
reporting: preserve complete raw traces and rejected instrumentation attempts locally; publish concise calibration, held-out, correction and audit summaries, exact hashes and null/adverse outcomes
